classification.difficultyReason: Build a graph through successive sums and three nested absolute values, retaining closely spaced corners.

answer.short:
$$y=\begin{cases}-x-1,&x<-1,\\x+1,&-1\le x<-\tfrac12,\\-3x-1,&-\tfrac12\le x<-\tfrac13,\\3x+1,&x\ge-\tfrac13.\end{cases}$$

Corners: $(-1,0)$, $(-\tfrac12,\tfrac12)$ and $(-\tfrac13,0)$; $y$-intercept $(0,1)$. Work from the innermost absolute value, adding $x$ and reflecting negative portions upwards at each stage.
answer.worked:
Start with $y=|x+1|$, then add the ordinates of $y=x$.

$$x+|x+1|=\begin{cases}-1,&x<-1,\\2x+1,&x\ge-1.\end{cases}$$

Reflect the negative portions upwards.

$$\left|x+|x+1|\right|=\begin{cases}1,&x<-1,\\-2x-1,&-1\le x<-\tfrac12,\\2x+1,&x\ge-\tfrac12.\end{cases}$$

Add $x$ again and reflect any negative portions upwards to apply the outer absolute value.

$$y=\begin{cases}-x-1,&x<-1,\\x+1,&-1\le x<-\tfrac12,\\-3x-1,&-\tfrac12\le x<-\tfrac13,\\3x+1,&x\ge-\tfrac13.\end{cases}$$

Join the corners $(-1,0)$, $(-\tfrac12,\tfrac12)$ and $(-\tfrac13,0)$ with straight segments. Extend the left ray with slope $-1$ and the right ray with slope $3$; the latter passes through $(0,1)$.

spec.description: Complete piecewise-linear graph with two negative-x intercepts and a small peak between them; dashed segments show the final reflection.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (-1,0), (-1/2,1/2), (-1/3,0); left slope -1 and right slope 3. Drawing decimals encode exact fractional vertices.
